This item weighs over 20kg, please ensure you have suitable assistance and transport when collecting from store.

Easy-to-use levelling compound. Apply up to a bed depth of 10mm (1-10mm in one application). Simply add water and mix. Use over various substrates to either level or raise the height of an existing floor to receive a final finish of floor tiles or vinyl. Ideal for restoring older, uneven floors to a level finish. Interior use only.
b: Can Receive Vinyl Coverings after 24 Hours
Can be Used with Underfloor Heating
